verdict.rationale: The README documents an explicit `yy skills update` command that selects the latest compatible stable release and updates all three agent copies in place (gh-6). It also describes how customized or unrecorded copies are flagged for review rather than overwritten (docs-3), backed by independently versioned skills (docs-20, docs-19). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the update command works, documented marketplace auto-update behavior, and fuller documentation of update and versioning semantics beyond a single line.
